name: Flight of Stars
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 2, ranger 2, shaman 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S, M (non-magical shurikens to be enchanted), DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one or more creatures, no two of which can be more than 15 feet apart
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

This special spell can only be learned and cast by divine spellcasters whose patron deity is [this god] and they possess the Evening Initiate feat. This spell enchants a non-magical shuriken to fly from your hand and unerringly strike its target (much like magic missile), though the damage does not change.

Specific parts of a creature cannot be singled out.

Inanimate objects (locks, etc.) cannot be damaged by the spell.

For every caster level above 1st, you can enchant an additional shuriken with this spell. If you shoot multiple shurikens, you can have them strike a single creature or several creatures. A single shuriken can only strike one creature. You may substitute non-magical caltrops in place of shurikens when casting this spell, with the caltrops dealing the same amount of damage as shurikens.
